item.title: Java XML Parsing: SAX, DOM, StAX, and Best Practices
item.description:
“Java XML Parsing: SAX, DOM, StAX, and Best Practices”

Effectively handling XML data in Java involves choosing the right parsing strategy. The Java API for XML Processing (JAXP) offers a standardized way to interact with XML, allowing for the use of different parser implementations without altering your core code. This promotes portability and ease of maintenance when parser technologies evolve.
